climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A wine region on the island of Pico in the Azores, known mainly for fortified wines and for its UNESCO listed vineyard landscape. Its rules allow only liqueur wine, from grapes such as Verdelho, Arinto, Sercial and Terrantez do Pico.
